title: Easy to use and an impressive presentation
text:
Easy to use and an impressive presentation. This mini Bundt Cake Pan features six one-cup cakes in three different designs based on classic Bundt pans. Although much smaller than their full-size counterparts, there is still an astonishing amount of detail, making these perfect for elegant individual desserts. For optimum "wow" factor, try dusting chocolate cakes with a light dusting of confectioner's sugar to bring out the details.

The included instructions say to use unsalted vegetable shortening or spray, but I used my ubiquitous Baker's Joy and had no problems unmolding the cakes from the pan (try shaking the pan gently side-to-side and front-to-back before unmolding for easier removal). Also, if you fill the molds the typical 2/3 full, you will probably have a couple of cups or so of batter left over from a recipe scaled for a 10-cup Bundt pan. The pan is a dream to clean and washes easily with hot soapy water (I refrained from using a nylon scrubber on the non-stick coating).

Perfect for special occasions, elegant romantic dinners, and individual easy-to-serve portions for office parties, this mini Bundt Pan from Nordic Ware is another solid performer from a company with a long tradition of excellent product performance and durability.
